notes: FleetComm 1.4.2 — the garble, found. The stretched, doubled radio on some launches was the audio output running at the wrong rate after a headset changed format (a Bluetooth headset dropping to its headset profile when the mic opens is the classic), not a busy machine. The app now notices within three seconds, re-opens the output itself and tells you in the COMM LOG ("audio output re-opened" then "back on rate") — no relaunch. CAM: while you stream, MY CAM shows STREAMING with the window you are sending. Callsigns: the callsign you enter is for this session only — it no longer changes your callsign on the fleet site.
